docs.description: Use for product behavior, architecture decisions, and documentation conventions

design-system.description: Use for UI/UX design tokens, brand identity, component specifications, and visual language

muse.description: Coordinator for the Muse Persian music ecosystem. Knows the full stack and delegates work across 8 specialized sub-agents (@auth, @player, @catalog, @social, @creator, @admin, @ui, @infra). Use for multi-domain tasks, cross-cutting changes, and architecture decisions.

muse-sre.description: Site Reliability Engineer for Muse. Monitors frontend (:5173) and API (:8080) health, detects crashes/runtime errors, restarts servers, and delegates fixes to the right sub-agent. Run the watchdog script with `bash scripts/watchdog.sh` for background monitoring.

muse-auth.description: Auth & Security agent for Muse. Login/register flows, JWT, token refresh, auth guards, session restoration.

muse-player.description: Player & Audio agent for Muse. Audio engine, queue, radio mode, visualizer, theatre, mini player, PiP, lyrics.

muse-catalog.description: Catalog & Search agent for Muse. Tracks, albums, artists, genres, search, playlists, library, history, recommendations, AI features.

muse-social.description: Social & Community agent for Muse. Social features, rooms, clubs, parties, notifications, reactions.

muse-creator.description: Creator & Gamification agent for Muse. Creator dashboard, badges, challenges, leaderboard, XP, tips, contributions, subscriptions.

muse-admin.description: Admin & Moderation agent for Muse. Admin panel, user management, track/album/artist CRUD, media upload, moderation.

muse-ui.description: UI/UX & Layout agent for Muse. App shell, common components, error pages, styling, utils, global stores.

muse-infra.description: Infrastructure agent for Muse. API barrel, router config, stores, services, plugins, composables root.
